name: Greater Transit Zone
description:
This dataset defines a single geographic boundary labeled the Greater Transit Zone. It contains one row with three fields: a zone label (gtz_qs) set to "Greater Transit Zone," plus the boundary's perimeter length (shape_leng) and enclosed area (shape_area) in the coordinate system's native units. Because the data consists of only one polygon, it serves as a reference outline rather than a table of multiple records.

The layer is most useful as a spatial mask or overlay. Planners and analysts could use it to clip or aggregate housing, development, or parcel data to the Greater Transit Zone, to map which properties or projects fall inside the zone, or to calculate the zone's total area for density and capacity comparisons. It can also be joined to other datasets as a geographic filter when studying transit-oriented development. Users should note that the length and area values reflect the projection used and may need conversion to familiar units such as square miles or kilometers.
